title: Transformer Protection Scheme Pakistan 2026 — 87T Differential, REF, Buchholz & OLTC Relay Complete Buyer Guide
author: CNC Electric Pakistan
summary_html: Complete transformer protection scheme guide for Pakistan 2026: 87T differential relay, REF, Buchholz relay, OLTC protection. IEC 60255 + NTDC Grid Code 2023 settings, CT specifications, 7 Pakistan-first risks (sympathetic inrush, cotton-fiber breather blockage, highland cold-start false alarms, OLTC grease failure, protection blind window, vector group mismatch), PKR price table (PKR 35K–3.2M), 10-point checklist, 7 common mistakes, 6-question FAQ. For 11kV/415V distribution transformers 100 kVA–2,500 kVA.
